```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  error = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9.0,
  fig.height = 5.0,
  dpi = 160
)
```

Every figure in this tutorial is built directly from **published *Arabidopsis thaliana* experimental datasets** bundled in `inst/extdata/` (provenance and DOIs in `arabidopsis-vignette-source.txt`):

- **TAIR10 nuclear genome & Giraut et al. (2011) centromeres** (`.fai`, `.bed`, and 500-kb protein-coding gene density `.bedgraph.gz`);
- **Kover et al. (2009) / Gnan et al. (2014) 19-founder `ArabMAGIC` population** ($n = 677$ phenotyped RILs scored at 1,251 TAIR10 SNPs for plant height, silique length, and bolting time);
- **TAIR10 / Araport11 GFF3 gene models** spanning the pleiotropic receptor-like kinase locus ***ERECTA* (`AT2G26330`)** on Chromosome 2;
- **Col-0 $\times$ Ler-0 genetic-to-physical Marey map** (399 validated markers in `cM` and `bp` across `Chr1–Chr5`);
- **Jiao & Schneeberger (2020) four-accession chromosome-level pangenome (`Col-0`, `Ler-0`, `Cvi-0`, `Eri-1`)** `SyRI` `.out.gz` structural rearrangements;
- **Wang et al. (2012) `MCScanX`** whole-genome duplication ($\alpha$-WGD) `.collinearity` blocks.

---

## 1. Whole-Genome Karyotype, Centromeres, `bedGraph` Gene Density & Multi-Trait GWAS

We start from three raw bioinformatics files:

1. `read_karyotype()` imports `arabidopsis-tair10.fai` (`Chr1–Chr5` lengths);
2. `read_chr_features()` imports `arabidopsis-centromeres.bed` (0-based BED $\rightarrow$ 1-based closed coordinates) and `arabidopsis-gene-density.bedgraph.gz` (TAIR10 protein-coding genes per Mb in 500-kb windows);
3. We overlay the genome-wide `ArabMAGIC` plant-height and bolting-time $-\log_{10} P$ scans, revealing two classic loci: ***ERECTA* (`Chr2:11.32 Mb`, $-\log_{10} P = 45.1$)** for plant height and ***GA1* / *FRIGIDA* (`Chr4:1.24 / 0.27 Mb`, $-\log_{10} P = 23.5$)** for bolting time.

```{r fig1-genome-gwas, fig.width = 9.2, fig.height = 5.4}
library(ggideogram)
library(ggplot2)

extdata <- function(name) system.file("extdata", name, package = "ggideogram")

# 1. Read TAIR10 FASTA index (.fai) and Giraut et al. (2011) centromere BED
tair10_kar <- read_karyotype(extdata("arabidopsis-tair10.fai"), format = "fai")
cen_bed <- read_chr_features(extdata("arabidopsis-centromeres.bed"), karyotype = tair10_kar)
tair10_kar$CE_start <- cen_bed$Start[match(tair10_kar$Chr, cen_bed$Chr)]
tair10_kar$CE_end   <- cen_bed$End[match(tair10_kar$Chr, cen_bed$Chr)]

# 2. Read 500-kb protein-coding gene density bedGraph (27,206 TAIR10 genes)
gene_bg <- read_chr_features(
  extdata("arabidopsis-gene-density.bedgraph.gz"),
  format = "bedgraph",
  karyotype = tair10_kar
)

# 3. Read real ArabMAGIC 1,251-SNP GWAS table (n = 677 lines)
gwas <- utils::read.delim(gzfile(extdata("arabidopsis-magic-gwas.tsv.gz")))
gwas_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(Chr = gwas$Chr, Pos = gwas$Pos, NegLogP = gwas$NegLog10P_height,
             Trait = "Plant height (ERECTA)"),
  data.frame(Chr = gwas$Chr, Pos = gwas$Pos, NegLogP = gwas$NegLog10P_bolting,
             Trait = "Bolting days (FRI / GA1)")
)

peaks <- data.frame(
  Chr = c("Chr2", "Chr4", "Chr4"),
  Pos = c(11324000, 269000, 1239000),
  Label = c("ERECTA (11.3 Mb)", "FRI (0.27 Mb)", "GA1 (1.24 Mb)")
)

p_genome <- ggideogram(
  tair10_kar,
  centromere = aes(start = CE_start, end = CE_end),
  orientation = "horizontal",
  chromosome_width = 1.05,
  chromosome_gap = 4.6,
  axis = TRUE,
  axis_units = "Mb",
  tracks = list(
    genes = geom_track(
      side = "overlay", width = 1,
      data = gene_bg,
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr, x = Mid, width = End - Start + 1, y = 1, fill = Value),
      geom = geom_tile()
    ),
    qtl = geom_track(
      side = "left", width = 2.6, gap = 0.25, limits = c(0, 48),
      data = gwas_long,
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr, x = Pos, y = NegLogP, colour = Trait),
      axis = list(breaks = c(0, 20, 40), size = 1.9),
      layers = list(
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.42, alpha = 0.9),
        geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05 / 1251), linetype = "dashed",
                   colour = "#475569", linewidth = 0.28)
      )
    )
  )
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F8FAFC", "#BAE6FD", "#0284C7", "#0C4A6E"),
    name = "Genes / Mb"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Plant height (ERECTA)" = "#DC2626", "Bolting days (FRI / GA1)" = "#2563EB"),
    name = "MAGIC GWAS (-log10 P)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Arabidopsis thaliana TAIR10 nuclear genome: gene density & MAGIC multi-trait GWAS",
    subtitle = "Overlay: Ensembl/TAIR10 protein-coding genes/Mb (bedGraph) with pericentromeric depletion; Upper tracks: ArabMAGIC GWAS (n = 677)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#475569"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5)
  )

p_genome
```

---

## 2. Multi-Scale QTL Fine-Mapping at *ERECTA* (`AT2G26330`) with `chr_view()` and `resolve_gene_models()`

Zooming into the Chromosome 2 peak (`11.195–11.232 Mb`), we combine three views into one publication figure with `patchwork`:

- **Panel A**: Full Chromosome 2 (`19.70 Mb`) with pericentromeric heterochromatin and a callout window over `11.2 Mb`;
- **Panel B**: `chr_view()` flat-cut local window pairing the `ArabMAGIC` association curve with `resolve_gene_models()` on `arabidopsis-erecta-locus.gff3.gz`, resolving all **27 exons of *ERECTA* (`AT2G26330`)** alongside neighboring protein-coding genes and non-coding RNA `AT2G26355`;
- **Panel C**: Real phenotypic distributions of plant height across the `ArabMAGIC` RILs stratified by `MASC06116` allele (`Col-like WT` vs. `Ler-like erecta`).

```{r fig2-erecta-finemap, fig.width = 9.4, fig.height = 5.6}
chr2_kar <- subset(tair10_kar, Chr == "Chr2")
erecta_gff <- read_chr_features(extdata("arabidopsis-erecta-locus.gff3.gz"), karyotype = chr2_kar)
erecta_models <- resolve_gene_models(erecta_gff)
erecta_models$Display <- ifelse(
  erecta_models$Gene == "AT2G26330",
  "ERECTA (AT2G26330)",
  erecta_models$Gene
)

# Panel A: Full Chr2 overview
p_chr2_top <- ggideogram(
  chr2_kar,
  centromere = aes(start = CE_start, end = CE_end),
  orientation = "horizontal",
  chromosome_width = 1.1,
  axis = TRUE, axis_side = "left", axis_units = "Mb", axis_size = 2.3,
  tracks = list(
    dens = geom_track(
      side = "overlay", width = 1,
      data = subset(gene_bg, Chr == "Chr2"),
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr, x = Mid, width = End - Start + 1, y = 1, fill = Value),
      geom = geom_tile()
    ),
    scan = geom_track(
      side = "left", width = 2.4, gap = 0.35, limits = c(0, 48),
      data = subset(gwas, Chr == "Chr2"),
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr, x = Pos, y = NegLog10P_height),
      label = list(text = "-log10(P)", size = 2.4),
      axis = list(breaks = c(0, 20, 40), size = 2.0),
      layers = list(
        geom_area(fill = "#FCA5A5", alpha = 0.45),
        geom_line(colour = "#B91C1C", linewidth = 0.5),
        geom_vline(xintercept = 11211000, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#111827")
      )
    )
  )
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#F8FAFC", "#BAE6FD", "#0284C7", "#0C4A6E"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(title = "A  Chr2 plant-height GWAS peak (11.2–11.3 Mb)") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold"))

# Panel B: Local TAIR10 gene models around ERECTA (Chr2: 11.196–11.231 Mb)
erecta_view <- chr_view(chr2_kar, chr = "Chr2", start = 11196000, end = 11231000)
p_erecta_zoom <- ggideogram(
  erecta_view,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  chromosome_width = 0.55,
  axis = TRUE, axis_side = "right", axis_units = "kb", axis_size = 2.2,
  tracks = list(
    models = geom_track(
      side = "right", width = 7.2, gap = 0.35,
      data = erecta_models,
      mapping = aes(
        chr = Chr, start = Start, end = End,
        type = Type, strand = Strand, gene = Gene,
        label = Display, fill = Strand
      ),
      label = list(text = "TAIR10 genes", size = 2.4),
      layers = list(
        geom_genemodel(
          mode = "gene", block_height = 0.55,
          label_size = 2.2, label_fontface = "italic"
        )
      )
    )
  )
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("+" = "#2563EB", "-" = "#DC2626"), name = "Strand") +
  labs(title = "B  TAIR10 gene models at ERECTA (27 exons, - strand)") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(3.2, "mm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7.8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5)
  )

# Panel C: Real phenotypic effect in ArabMAGIC (n = 626 lines with complete calls)
erecta_pheno <- utils::read.delim(gzfile(extdata("arabidopsis-magic-erecta-pheno.tsv.gz")))
p_allelic <- ggplot(erecta_pheno, aes(MASC06116, Height_cm, fill = MASC06116)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.35, width = 0.75, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.28, outlier.size = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Col-like (WT)" = "#2563EB", "Ler-like (erecta)" = "#DC2626"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "C  MAGIC height by allele",
    subtitle = sprintf("MASC06116 (n = %d RILs)", nrow(erecta_pheno)),
    x = NULL, y = "Plant height (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7.8, colour = "#475569"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7.8)
  )

if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ((p_chr2_top / p_erecta_zoom) + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.45))) |
    p_allelic + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(2.4, 1))
} else {
  p_erecta_zoom
}
```

## 3. RIL Graphical Genotypes (Discrete `y` BinMap + `geom_rug()` + `geom_smooth()`)

In quantitative genetics and breeding, recombinant inbred lines (RILs) and chromosome segment substitution lines (CSSLs) are inspected via graphical genotype **BinMaps**. Because `geom_track()` natively accepts discrete `factor` or `character` `y` mappings, we can plot the actual `Chr2` Col-0 vs. Ler-0 haplotype blocks of 8 contrasting `ArabMAGIC` RILs (`4` tall lines carrying `Col-0` at `11.21 Mb` vs. `4` compact *erecta* lines carrying `Ler-0` at `11.21 Mb`), with SNP genotyping positions drawn along the track border by `geom_rug()`.

```{r fig3-magic-binmap, fig.width = 9.2, fig.height = 5.0}
binmap <- utils::read.delim(extdata("arabidopsis-magic-chr2-binmap.tsv"))
line_order <- unique(binmap$Line)
binmap$Line <- factor(binmap$Line, levels = line_order)

chr2_gwas <- subset(gwas, Chr == "Chr2")
chr2_inf_snps <- subset(chr2_gwas, Col_allele != Ler_allele & Col_allele %in% c("A", "B") & Ler_allele %in% c("A", "B"))

ggideogram(
  chr2_kar,
  centromere = aes(start = CE_start, end = CE_end),
  orientation = "horizontal",
  chromosome_width = 0.85,
  axis = TRUE, axis_side = "left", axis_units = "Mb", axis_size = 2.3,
  tracks = list(
    lod = geom_track(
      side = "left", width = 2.5, gap = 0.35, limits = c(0, 48),
      data = chr2_gwas,
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr, x = Pos, y = NegLog10P_height),
      label = list(text = "Height GWAS", size = 2.4),
      axis = list(breaks = c(0, 20, 40), size = 2.0),
      layers = list(
        geom_point(size = 0.75, colour = "#64748B", alpha = 0.65),
        geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, span = 0.18, se = TRUE,
                    colour = "#B91C1C", fill = "#FCA5A5", linewidth = 0.55),
        geom_vline(xintercept = 11211000, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#111827", linewidth = 0.4)
      )
    ),
    ril = geom_track(
      side = "right", width = 7.4, gap = 0.4,
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr),
      label = list(text = "Founders & RILs", size = 2.4),
      axis = list(position = "start", size = 2.05, tick_length = 1.0),
      layers = list(
        geom_rect(
          data = binmap,
          mapping = aes(xmin = Start - 1, xmax = End, y = Line, fill = State),
          height = 0.84, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15
        ),
        geom_hline(yintercept = 2.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#111827", linewidth = 0.35),
        geom_hline(yintercept = 6.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#475569", linewidth = 0.30),
        geom_vline(xintercept = 11211000, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#111827", linewidth = 0.4),
        geom_rug(
          data = chr2_inf_snps,
          mapping = aes(x = Pos),
          sides = "b", length = 0.08, colour = "#1E293B", linewidth = 0.22
        )
      )
    )
  )
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Col-like" = "#3B82F6", "Ler-like" = "#EF4444"),
    labels = c("Col-like" = "Col-0 allele (WT)", "Ler-like" = "Ler-0 allele (erecta)"),
    name = "Haplotype segment"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "ArabMAGIC Chromosome 2 graphical genotypes (discrete y BinMap) & SNP rug at ERECTA",
    subtitle = "Every tall RIL (51–56 cm) carries the Col-0 segment at 11.21 Mb (dotted line), whereas every dwarf RIL (19–22 cm) carries Ler-0"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.3, colour = "#475569"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.8),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(3.5, "mm")
  )
```

## 4. Genetic (`cM`) vs. Physical (`Mb`) Marey Map & Pericentromeric Recombination Suppression

Using the published Col-0 $\times$ Ler-0 genetic-physical marker map (`arabidopsis-mareymap.tsv`, 109 markers on Chromosome 4 spanning `110.4 cM` and `18.59 Mb`), we pair a centiMorgan linkage group (`units = "cM"`) with the physical TAIR10 chromosome (`units = "Mb"`) under `scale_length = "per_chr"`, while fitting a LOESS Marey curve (`geom_smooth()`) on the physical chromosome. Notice how genetic links fan horizontally across the `1.61–5.08 Mb` centromere + heterochromatic knob *hk4S* where meiotic crossover is suppressed (flat plateau on the Marey curve).

```{r fig4-marey-chr4, fig.width = 9.0, fig.height = 4.6}
marey <- utils::read.delim(extdata("arabidopsis-mareymap.tsv"))
marey_chr4 <- subset(marey, Chr == "Chr4")

marey_sem <- as_ideogram_data(
  data.frame(
    Genome = c("Genetic", "Physical"),
    Chr = c("LG4", "Chr4"),
    Start = c(0, 0),
    End = c(112, 18585056),
    CE_start = c(NA, subset(tair10_kar, Chr == "Chr4")$CE_start),
    CE_end = c(NA, subset(tair10_kar, Chr == "Chr4")$CE_end),
    Label = c("LG4 (Col x Ler, cM)", "Chr4 (TAIR10, Mb)")
  ),
  mapping = aes(genome = Genome, chr = Chr, start = Start, end = End, label = Label),
  centromere = aes(start = CE_start, end = CE_end)
)

marey_links <- data.frame(
  G_chr = chr_key("Genetic", "LG4"),
  G_cM  = marey_chr4$Gen_cM,
  P_chr = chr_key("Physical", "Chr4"),
  P_bp  = marey_chr4$Phys_bp
)
marey_chr4$Phys_key <- chr_key("Physical", "Chr4")

ggideogram(
  marey_sem,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  scale_length = "per_chr",
  chromosome_width = 0.95,
  chromosome_gap = 8.2,
  tracks = list(
    curve = geom_track(
      side = "right", width = 3.0, gap = 0.4,
      chr = chr_key("Physical", "Chr4"),
      limits = c(0, 115),
      data = marey_chr4,
      mapping = aes(chr = Phys_key, x = Phys_bp, y = Gen_cM),
      label = list(text = "Cumulative cM", size = 2.4),
      axis = list(breaks = c(0, 50, 100), size = 2.0),
      layers = list(
        geom_point(size = 0.7, colour = "#0F766E", alpha = 0.7),
        geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, span = 0.22, se = TRUE,
                    colour = "#115E59", fill = "#99F6E4", linewidth = 0.55)
      )
    )
  )
) +
  geom_chrlink(
    data = marey_links[seq(1, nrow(marey_links), by = 2), ],
    mapping = aes(chr1 = G_chr, position1 = G_cM, chr2 = P_chr, position2 = P_bp),
    colour = "#475569", alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.28, curvature = 0.14
  ) +
  geom_chr(
    chr = chr_key("Genetic", "LG4"), component = "axis",
    side = "left", units = "cM", breaks = seq(0, 110, by = 20), size = 2.3
  ) +
  geom_chr(
    chr = chr_key("Physical", "Chr4"), component = "axis",
    side = "right", units = "Mb", gap = 3.8, size = 2.3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Chromosome 4 genetic-to-physical synteny (cM vs. Mb) & Marey recombination curve",
    subtitle = "109 Col x Ler markers: crossover suppression across the 1.6–5.1 Mb centromere / hk4S knob creates a flat Marey plateau"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.3, colour = "#475569")
  )
```

---

## 5. Four-Genome *Arabidopsis* Pangenome Stack with Direct `SyRI` `.out.gz` Imports

Why is meiotic recombination completely suppressed between `Col-0` and `Ler-0` around `1.6–2.8 Mb` on the short arm of Chromosome 4? Using `read_chr_links(..., format = "syri")` on the published chromosome-level assemblies of **Col-0**, **Ler-0**, **Cvi-0**, and **Eri-1** (Jiao & Schneeberger, 2020, *Nature Communications*), we directly plot all primary `SyRI` structural blocks ($\ge 15\text{ kb}$) on `Chr4`—immediately exposing the **1.17-Mb heterochromatic knob (*hk4S*) inversion (`INV`)** that differentiates `Col-0` from `Ler-0`, plus inter-accession translocations (`TRANS` / `INVTR`) and duplications (`DUP`).

```{r fig5-pangenome-syri, fig.width = 9.2, fig.height = 5.2}
pan_len <- utils::read.delim(extdata("arabidopsis-pangenome-chrlen.tsv"))
pan_chr4 <- subset(pan_len, Chr == "Chr4")
pan_chr4$Label <- paste0(pan_chr4$Genome, " · Chr4")

pan_sem <- as_ideogram_data(
  pan_chr4,
  mapping = aes(genome = Genome, chr = Chr, start = Start, end = End, label = Label)
)

syri_12 <- read_chr_links(
  extdata("arabidopsis-col-ler-chr34.syri.out.gz"),
  format = "syri", min_length = 25000,
  target_genome = "Col-0", query_genome = "Ler-0"
)
syri_23 <- read_chr_links(
  extdata("arabidopsis-ler-cvi-chr34.syri.out.gz"),
  format = "syri", min_length = 25000,
  target_genome = "Ler-0", query_genome = "Cvi-0"
)
syri_34 <- read_chr_links(
  extdata("arabidopsis-cvi-eri-chr34.syri.out.gz"),
  format = "syri", min_length = 25000,
  target_genome = "Cvi-0", query_genome = "Eri-1"
)

syri_all <- rbind(syri_12, syri_23, syri_34)
syri_chr4 <- subset(
  syri_all,
  grepl("Chr4$", Chr1) & grepl("Chr4$", Chr2)
)
syri_chr4$Class <- ifelse(
  syri_chr4$Type == "SYN", "Syntenic (SYN)",
  ifelse(syri_chr4$Type %in% c("INV", "INVTR", "INVDP"),
         "Inversion (INV / INVTR)", "Translocation / Dup")
)
syri_chr4 <- syri_chr4[order(syri_chr4$Class != "Syntenic (SYN)"), ]

ggideogram(
  pan_sem,
  orientation = "horizontal",
  ncol = 4,
  chromosome_width = 0.95,
  chromosome_gap = 6.5,
  axis = TRUE,
  axis_units = "Mb"
) +
  geom_chrlink(
    data = syri_chr4,
    mapping = aes(
      chr1 = Chr1, start1 = Start1, end1 = End1,
      chr2 = Chr2, start2 = Start2, end2 = End2,
      orientation = Orientation, fill = Class
    ),
    alpha = 0.62
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Syntenic (SYN)" = "#CBD5E1",
      "Inversion (INV / INVTR)" = "#DC2626",
      "Translocation / Dup" = "#2563EB"
    ),
    name = "SyRI rearrangement (>= 25 kb)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Four-genome Arabidopsis Chromosome 4 pangenome stack (Col-0, Ler-0, Cvi-0, Eri-1)",
    subtitle = "Direct read_chr_links(format = 'syri') output highlighting the 1.17-Mb hk4S short-arm inversion (1.6–2.8 Mb) in Col-0 vs. Ler-0"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.3, colour = "#475569"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.8),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(3.5, "mm")
  )
```

---

## 6. Circular Whole-Genome `MCScanX` $\alpha$-WGD Synteny & Native `scale_x_chromosome()` Axis

Finally, we combine two genome-wide views side by side:

1. **Left**: `read_chr_links(..., format = "mcscanx", collapse_blocks = TRUE)` parses the official `MCScanX` `.collinearity` and `.gff` tables across all five *Arabidopsis* chromosomes into a circular synteny plot with an outer `bedGraph` gene-density ring and closing-gap numeric axis;
2. **Right**: `scale_x_chromosome()` places proportional chromosome silhouettes (with Giraut et al. centromere waists!) directly into the discrete x-axis guide of an ordinary `ggplot()` violin + boxplot comparing gene density across `Chr1–Chr5`.

```{r fig6-circular-mcscanx-axis, fig.width = 9.4, fig.height = 4.8}
wgd_blocks <- read_chr_links(
  extdata("arabidopsis-mcscanx.collinearity.gz"),
  format = "mcscanx",
  genes = extdata("arabidopsis-mcscanx.gff.gz"),
  collapse_blocks = TRUE,
  karyotype = tair10_kar
)

p_circ <- ggideogram(
  tair10_kar,
  centromere = aes(start = CE_start, end = CE_end),
  orientation = "circular",
  radius = 18,
  opening_angle = 34,
  name_size = 2.9,
  tracks = list(
    dens = geom_track(
      side = "outer", width = 3.2, gap = 0.35, limits = c(0, 400),
      data = gene_bg,
      mapping = aes(chr = Chr, x = Mid, y = Value),
      label = list(text = "Genes/Mb", size = 2.2),
      axis = list(breaks = c(0, 200, 400), size = 1.9),
      layers = list(
        geom_area(fill = "#BAE6FD", alpha = 0.7),
        geom_line(colour = "#0369A1", linewidth = 0.35)
      )
    )
  )
) +
  geom_chrlink(
    data = wgd_blocks,
    mapping = aes(
      chr1 = Chr1, start1 = Start1, end1 = End1,
      chr2 = Chr2, start2 = Start2, end2 = End2,
      orientation = Orientation, fill = Orientation
    ),
    alpha = 0.48
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("+" = "#3B82F6", "-" = "#EF4444"),
    labels = c("+" = "Collinear (+)", "-" = "Inverted (-)"),
    name = "MCScanX WGD block"
  ) +
  labs(title = "A  Circular MCScanX WGD synteny") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9.8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7.8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5),
    legend.key.size = grid::unit(3.2, "mm")
  )

p_chr_axis <- ggplot(gene_bg, aes(Chr, Value, fill = Chr)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.35, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.24, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_chromosome(
    tair10_kar,
    centromere = aes(start = CE_start, end = CE_end)
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "B  Native chromosome x-axis guide",
    subtitle = "500-kb window gene density across TAIR10 chromosomes",
    x = NULL, y = "Protein-coding genes / Mb"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9.8, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "#475569"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  p_circ | p_chr_axis + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(1.15, 1))
} else {
  p_circ
}
```
